svg.title: Löyly spec v2: the event storm, 27 domain events in time order across 6 bounded contexts

a.title: Empty title headings reported: The stamper found Scenario headings with nothing after the colon in a slice's spec file: not items, never stamped or counted, and reported loudly by line so the author sees them (legacy @harness-021; decisions.md, R2 question 6). (Spec author · Stamp slice)

Scenario stamped: A scenario received its item identity, @item-<slice>-<number>. It keeps it through every rewording; the scenario digest, not the identity, changes with the behavior. (Spec author · Stamp slice)
Checklist derived: A cut's checklist was derived: its stamped items, its total (the denominator) and the slices skipped by status. (Operator · Derive checklist)

Item verdicts filed: One grader's verdicts for a cycle's gated candidate were filed, as returned: pass or fail per item, duplicates included. A verdict offered without evidence is filed with empty evidence, "" (invariant EvidenceDefaultsEmpty). (Grader · File item verdicts)

Measurement filed: A cycle's one measurement was filed: a pass or fail verdict for every checklist item, the denominator of its checklist, unreached items failed with their reason, and any verdict superseded by a later one for the same item. It cannot be untaken. (ORC runtime · File score)

Moved item set restated: The item set moved since the last measured cycle of the same selection, so the two headline rates count different things; the comparison is restated on the shared items only. (Report scoreboard)

Score stage failed: The cycle's score was refused, so no measurement was filed and the score stage failed; it is not retried within the cycle. Not scored is not all failed. (ORC runtime · Fail score stage)

Scoreboard reported: The cycle's scoreboard was reported to a person: its rate, and against the last measured cycle of the same selection (decisions.md g: the same selected slices by name, across cuts; whole-plan with whole-plan) the shared items' rates, newly passing and newly failing items apart, new items as the untuned holdout and dropped items. No net is computed. A baseline cycle has no previous cycle. A rate has one decimal, rounded half to even, and is "n/a" over zero. (Report scoreboard)
Instrument golden moved: An instrument golden moved to new content, with its one recorded reason. (Instrument maintainer · Move instrument golden)

Instrument golden written: An instrument golden was written from its scenario, never recorded from a run; it carries the digest of that scenario (decisions.md h). (Instrument maintainer · Write instrument golden)
Candidate installed in gate room: The attempt's candidate is installed in a fresh gate room. (ORC runtime · Install candidate in gate room)

Candidate regenerated: A candidate was regenerated for the cycle's next gate attempt: its digest, its attempt and purpose, and the candidate it repairs. It dies with the cycle. (ORC runtime · Record regenerated candidate)

Clean room proved: The cycle's clean room is proved: a single-commit repository of the cut in which every fenced path is absent from the working tree and the object graph. (ORC runtime · Prove clean room)

Cycle failed: The cycle concluded failed at a named stage for a named reason. Recorded once. A cycle failed before the score has no measurement, and shows as 'no score', never as all failed. (ORC runtime · Fail cycle)
Cycle passed: The cycle concluded passed: the gate ratified its candidate and its measurement is filed and reported. Recorded once. (Pass cycle)

Gate attempt failed: The gate failed this attempt, naming the first guard that did not hold and the gate evidence a repair builder may read. Gate evidence only: never score evidence. (ORC runtime · Record gate attempt)

Gate attempt passed: The gate ratified this attempt's candidate: booted fresh through its launch entrypoint within the boot budget (the margin is recorded), identity proved, suite green. Done is this verdict, never the builder's claim. (ORC runtime · Record gate attempt)

Gate attempt refused: The gate refused to grade this attempt for infrastructure: nothing was booted or graded and no attempt was spent. Counted: three in a row fail the cycle (R2 question 2). (ORC runtime · Record gate refusal)

Harness self check failed: The harness failed its self-check for this cycle; the failing check is named. Before the fence no clean room is built; before a gate attempt nothing is booted or graded and no attempt is spent; the cycle fails. (ORC runtime · Record harness self check)

Harness self check passed: The harness passed its self-check for this cycle, occasion and attempt, at this harness digest, these goldens and this identity probe, with any missing tool listed as a skip. Before the fence a cycle starts here: it is the first fact that names the cycle, its cut and its budget. (ORC runtime · Record harness self check)
Source cut pinned: A source cut was pinned: one commit and its tree content, immutable from now on. (Operator · Pin source cut)
Effect recorded: An effect was performed and its result recorded into a context: the method, and the context's reply as heard. (Cycle runner · Record effect)
Handoff relayed: A producer's handoff was handed in to one consumer, unchanged, and the consumer accepted or refused it. (Cycle runner · Relay handoff)

Run concluded: The run concluded as its cycle did: passed, or failed at the cycle's stage for the cycle's reason. cycle is the Regeneration cycle's progress of the cycle as read at the conclusion, verbatim. (Conclude run)
Run halted: The run halted: an effect could not be performed, so nothing was recorded for it. Loud, and never the cycle's conclusion. (Cycle runner · Halt run)
Run started: A run of one cycle started: its cut, commit, selection, budget and approved grader digests, and the five contexts started for it. (Operator · Start run)
Verdicts handed in: The verdicts file of the gated candidate was handed in: its path, its digest, the grader digest and the number of verdicts it holds. (Operator · Hand in verdicts)
